title: VergeSense Strengthens Lead in Occupancy Intelligence Market with Expert Insights
summary: VergeSense builds on its industry momentum, offering unmatched occupancy intelligence and AI-driven insights via webinars, events, and global platform growth.
body_markdown:
By: officeinsight


VergeSense continues to accelerate its momentum in the occupancy intelligence industry by delivering precise, enterprise-grade occupancy analytics across global portfolios. At CoreNet Global's Singapore event, featured speakers such as CTO Kelby Green reinforced VergeSense’s expertise in AI-driven spatial optimization. The article highlights how the Occupancy Intelligence Platform empowers real estate and facilities teams to make better CRE decisions with confidence.


[Read More](https://officeinsight.com/officenewswire/vergesense-continues-momentum-in-occupancy-intelligence-market/)
